mapper.update: UPDATE `group` SET member_count = COALESCE(member_count, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{groupId} AND status = 1 AND (max_members IS NULL OR COALESCE(member_count, 0) < max_members)
UPDATE `group` SET member_count = member_count - 1 WHERE id = #{groupId} AND member_count > 0
mapper.select: SELECT g.* FROM `group` g JOIN group_member gm ON g.id = gm.group_id WHERE gm.user_id = #{userId} AND g.status = 1 AND gm.join_status = 'ACCEPTED' AND gm.kicked_at IS NULL AND (gm.role IN (2, 3) OR (gm.role = 1 AND gm.user_id = g.owner_id))
SELECT * FROM `group` WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status = 1
SELECT * FROM `group` WHERE status = 1 AND is_visible = 1 AND (group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(id AS CHAR) = #{keyword}) ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `group` WHERE status = 1 AND is_visible = 1 AND (group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(id AS CHAR) = #{keyword})

SELECT g.id, g.shared_chat_id as sharedChatId, g.group_name as groupName, g.group_description as groupDescription, g.owner_id as ownerId, u.username as ownerUsername, g.group_avatar_url as groupAvatarUrl, g.status, g.max_members as maxMembers, g.member_count as memberCount, gm.role, CASE gm.role WHEN 1 THEN 'OWNER' WHEN 2 THEN 'ADMIN' WHEN 3 THEN 'MEMBER' END as currentUserRole, g.create_time as createdAt, g.last_transfer_at as lastTransferAt, g.transfer_count as transferCount FROM `group` g LEFT JOIN user u ON g.owner_id = u.id LEFT JOIN group_member gm ON g.id = gm.group_id AND gm.user_id = #{userId} WHERE gm.user_id = #{userId} AND g.status = 1 AND gm.join_status = 'ACCEPTED' AND gm.kicked_at IS NULL AND (gm.role IN (2, 3) OR (gm.role = 1 AND gm.user_id = g.owner_id)) ORDER BY g.create_time DESC
